thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — launching a sprint-zero working session for the Systems Integrator Velocity onramp next Wed 9am PT. Goal: ship the public playbook + cert rubric + hands-on lab (sandbox) by end of Q2. Who can take ownership of curriculum and sandbox infra?

samir: I can own sandbox infra and voucher allocations. Need a firm list of HW partners and estimated seats. Also: who will own marketplace listing walkthrough?

lena: I’ll draft the curriculum outline. Thinking 3 modules: (1) Redwood fundamentals + runtime, (2) Marketplace integration + listing, (3) SI go-to-market checklist + cert prep. Will post a slide skeleton by Tue.

danielle: I can take module 2 (marketplace integration). Need a sample dev account and a short script showing step-by-step listing flow. Also want a hands-on exercise to repro a redwood model endpoint in the SI sandbox.

samir: For vouchers — estimated 30 seats for pilot. Can we confirm H100 access vs. Ampere? Partnerships, please confirm which partners will provide hardware for labs.

maya: Adding the partners list here: rackscale (H100), cloudwave (Ampere), edgebox (GPU partners). @samir can you ping procurement to confirm voucher limits?

ops-bot: Reminder: create calendar event for "SI Velocity onramp — sprint-zero" and add conference room + Zoom. Event created: Wed 09:00 PT.

lena: Draft agenda (WIP):
```
09:00 - 09:15 Intro & success metrics (Maya)
09:15 - 10:00 Curriculum mapping + owners (Lena)
10:00 - 10:30 Sandbox infra plan & voucher allocation (Samir)
10:30 - 11:00 Marketplace lab design (Danielle)
11:00 - 11:30 Cert rubric & pilot gating (All)
```

maya: Success metrics we should track: time-to-first-listing (target < 2 days), sandbox repro steps completed by partner, cert pass rate >= 80% for pilot cohort. Also customer-facing playbook must include rollback and support SLA notes.

danielle: For the hands-on, proposed exercises: create listing, deploy model, validate latency with perf script, and file a support ticket. Perf script snippet I’ll add to the repo.

samir: Operational checklist items: networking whitelists, KMS access, ECR repo permissions, quota bump procedure. I'll compile into a one-pager ops playbook.

lena: Certification rubric quick notes: knowledge check (20%), lab practical (60%), customer-facing scenario (20%). Need SME reviewers — @danielle and @samir can be reviewers?

danielle: Yep — can review lab practicals.

maya: Great. Action items: Lena = curriculum draft (Tue EOD), Samir = voucher confirmation + ops checklist (Thu), Danielle = marketplace lab exercise + perf script (Thu), Maya = playbook template + PR process (Fri). We'll reconvene Mon for pre-flight.

samir: One more ask — can Partnerships push partner contacts for support hours during pilot? We may need 24/7 window for first 48 hrs of cohort.

maya: Noted. I'll escalate to partner ops.

ops-bot: Reaction recorded: :calendar: event set.

lena: Tiny ask — can we include a short "what to bring" email for SIs (creds, SSH keys, contact person)? I'll draft and send.

maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone — excited to get this moving. :rocket:
